pulls.title: 8396910: RISC-V: Sign-extend the BigInteger mulAdd intrinsic result
pulls.author: zifeihan
pulls.activity: 已关闭、7 个 Review、3 条评论
pulls.body_excerpt: The RISC-V BigInteger.implMulAdd intrinsic returns its carry zero-extended, whereas its Java int result must be sign-extended to satisfy the integer-register convention. For negative carries, this can cause incorrect results in subsequent integer comparisons. This change sign-extends the result at the common exit, preserving unsigned carry arithmetic inside the loop. A regression test in compiler/c2/riscv64/TestMulAddSignExtension.java checks zero, positive, and negative carries across tail-loop and unrolled-loop boundaries. Testing: TestMulAddSignExtension fails before the fix and passes afte

pulls.title: 8394484: C2 stack bang on Windows can lead to non-recoverable crash
pulls.author: raneashay
pulls.body_excerpt: Without this patch, HotSpot uses `VirtualAlloc()` with `MEM_COMMIT` to make Windows convert stack pages from "reserved" to "committed", but doing so does not update the `StackLimit` field in the Thread Environment Block (TEB) tracked by Windows. Subsequent use of the stack by HotSpot can cause the stack pointer to be _below_ `StackLimit`, which breaks the invariant expected by the Win32 API functions like `__chkstk()`. The RISC-V sequence consists of an `AUIPC/JALR` pair followed by a 32-bit trap request. pulls.title: 8395359: RISC-V: Add C2 VectorSlice support
pulls.author: DingliZhang
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, please consider. The RISC-V C2 backend currently has no matching rule for `VectorSlice`. Constant-origin Vector API slice operations therefore use the Java fallback, which introduces additional shuffle, rearrange and blend operations. The IR byte offset is converted to a lane offset, and the slice is implemented using `vslidedown` and `vslideup`.
